1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralJunctionAngles
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralNetPlacement
3 
4 /-! The junction chains settle nine more pairs of actual developed subdivision triangles. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
7 
8 open OctahedralTriangles OctahedralNet
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
11 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
13 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
14 
15 /-- One of the eight actual closed triangles in the constructed planar development. -/
16 def placedTriangle (index : FaceIndex) : Set Plane :=
17   net.place index '' graph.triangle (OctahedralNet.triangle source slit index)
18 
19 /-- The four triangle indices around an uncut equator junction, in cyclic order. -/
20 def junctionIndex (i : Fin 3) : Fin 4 → FaceIndex :=
21   ![(true, i.castSucc), (false, i.castSucc), (false, i.succ), (true, i.succ)]
22 
23 theorem junction_triangle (i : Fin 3) (k : Fin 4) :
24     (net.junctionChain i).triangle k = net.placedTriangle (junctionIndex i k) := by
25   fin_cases k
26   · change convexHull ℝ ({(net.patch i.castSucc).right, (net.patch i.castSucc).apex, (net.patch i.castSucc).left} : Set Plane) =
27       net.petal i.castSucc '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + i.castSucc))
28     rw [net.petal_triangle]
29     congr 1
30     ext z
31     simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
32     tauto
33   · change convexHull ℝ ({(net.patch i.castSucc).right, (net.patch i.castSucc).left, (net.patch i.castSucc).pole} : Set Plane) =
34       net.fan.place i.castSucc '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle (opposite source) (slit + i.castSucc))
35     rw [net.fan_triangle]
36     congr 1
37     ext z
38     simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
39     tauto
40   · change convexHull ℝ ({(net.patch i.castSucc).right, (net.patch i.castSucc).pole, (net.patch i.succ).right} : Set Plane) =
41       net.fan.place i.succ '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle (opposite source) (slit + i.succ))
42     rw [net.fan_triangle, net.consecutive_patch_corner, net.patch_pole, net.patch_pole]
43     congr 1
44     exact Set.insert_comm _ _ _
45   · change convexHull ℝ ({(net.patch i.castSucc).right, (net.patch i.succ).right, (net.patch i.succ).apex} : Set Plane) =
46       net.petal i.succ '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + i.succ))
47     rw [net.petal_triangle, net.consecutive_patch_corner]
48     congr 1
49     ext z
50     simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
51     tauto
52 
53 /-- Two indexed triangles are safe when their planar interiors are disjoint. -/
54 def Separated (a b : FaceIndex) : Prop :=
55   Disjoint (interior (net.placedTriangle a)) (interior (net.placedTriangle b))
56 
57 theorem Separated.symm {a b : FaceIndex} (safe : net.Separated a b) : net.Separated b a := Disjoint.symm safe
58 
59 theorem junction_separated (i : Fin 3) (j k : Fin 4) (different : j ≠ k) :
60     net.Separated (junctionIndex i j) (junctionIndex i k) := by
61   have safe := net.junction_nonoverlap i j k different
62   rw [net.junction_triangle, net.junction_triangle] at safe
63   exact safe
64 
65 theorem neighboring_fan_petal (i : Fin 3) : net.Separated (false, i.castSucc) (true, i.succ) :=
66   net.junction_separated i 1 3 (by decide)
67 
68 theorem neighboring_petal_fan (i : Fin 3) : net.Separated (true, i.castSucc) (false, i.succ) :=
69   net.junction_separated i 0 2 (by decide)
70 
71 theorem neighboring_petals (i : Fin 3) : net.Separated (true, i.castSucc) (true, i.succ) :=
72   net.junction_separated i 0 3 (by decide)
73 
74 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
